title: Text stands out clearly from its background
why: Faint text is hard or impossible to read for people with low vision or color blindness, and for anyone in bright light.
how_to_fix: Make the text darker or the background lighter, or the other way around. Normal text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1. Large text (about 24px, or about 19px if bold) needs at least 3 to 1. A contrast checker tool can tell you the ratio of two colors.

title: Images have a text description
why: Screen readers read the description out loud instead of showing the image. Without one, people hear the file name or nothing at all.
how_to_fix: Add an alt attribute to every . Describe what the image shows or what it is for. If the image is only decoration, use an empty alt (alt="") so screen readers skip it.

title: Form fields have labels
why: Screen readers read a field's label to tell people what to type. Without one, people just hear "edit text" and have to guess.
how_to_fix: Add a <label> element and connect it to the field with matching for and id attributes, or put the field inside the label. Placeholder text is not a label. If there is truly no room for visible text, add aria-label (a name only screen readers hear), but a visible label helps everyone.

title: Links have text that screen readers can read
why: A link with no text, such as an icon-only link, is read out as just "link". People cannot tell where it goes.
how_to_fix: Put text inside the link. For an icon-only link, give the icon image alt text, or add aria-label (a name only screen readers hear) to the link, saying where it goes.

title: Buttons have names that screen readers can read
why: A button with no text, such as an icon-only button, is read out as just "button". People cannot tell what it does.
how_to_fix: Put text inside the button. For an icon-only button, add aria-label (a name only screen readers hear) that says what it does, for example aria-label="Close".

title: The page says which language it is in
why: Screen readers use the page language to pick the right voice and pronunciation. Without it, the words may be read in the wrong accent or language.
how_to_fix: Add a lang attribute with a valid language code to the <html> element. For example, <html lang="en"> for English or <html lang="es"> for Spanish.
